mapper.select: SELECT id, customer_id, service_item_id, starts_on, ends_on, status, granted_by, updated_by, change_reason, created_at, updated_at, row_version FROM it_service_entitlement WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, customer_id, service_item_id, starts_on, ends_on, status, granted_by, updated_by, change_reason, created_at, updated_at, row_version FROM it_service_entitlement WHERE customer_id = #{customer} AND service_item_id = #{service} FOR UPDATE

SELECT e.service_item_id FROM it_service_entitlement e JOIN it_service_item s ON s.id = e.service_item_id AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE e.customer_id = #{customer} AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' AND DATE(UTC_TIMESTAMP() + INTERVAL 8 HOUR) BETWEEN e.starts_on AND e.ends_on ORDER BY e.service_item_id LIMIT 1
